lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments traversing the torso; spacing is approximately equidistant in the mid-section, becoming more compressed toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A singular Y-shaped bifurcation is observed at the dorsal origin of the third line from the posterior rump.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The four most anterior lines exhibit significant vertical abbreviation, terminating mid-torso before reaching the ventral boundary; two dashed segments are visible on the lower posterior flank.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior flank, situated between the vertical line terminations and the hind limb origin.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a posterior-superior vector at approximately 40-45 degrees relative to the orbital plane with a slight inward terminal convergence.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 1.2x the total width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies the distal 15-20% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking present on the nasal bridge; dark dorsal mane extending from the occipital region to the rump; distinct white 'sock' markings on the lower distal limbs.
